descriptionMarkdown:
Basically it my backup of my usual starter base, you can use it if you want. I have redesigned it so there could be mistakes hidden. 

Start with smelters and work your way into what you need. Mall is all the way in the back, you can build an early mall in the top left corner.

This is a barebones Base and needs some upgrading. When upgraded it will provided 45 SPM.

title: KideMirror's Starter Base (early access)
